item.title: Visa and Mercuryo make cashing out crypto a matter of minutes
item.content:encoded:
## Visa and Mercuryo make cashing out crypto a matter of minutes
We’ve become a Visa partner, enabling faster, easier, and more secure crypto transfers via Visa Direct, Visa’s near real-time payment platform. No more waiting for traditional bank processing or sharing bank account details. Visa card number is all it takes.
You’ve been there. Wallet to exchange, exchange to bank, hidden fees, repeated verifications, and days of waiting. This isn’t how cashing out should go. So now it doesn’t.
Now all you need to do is choose Visa when withdrawing crypto in the [Mercuryo widget](https://exchange.mercuryo.io). No exchanges to juggle. No banks in between. And no P2P. Just a clear flow that turns crypto into money on Visa card in minutes.
With this feature, millions of users can convert crypto to fiat in a simple, intuitive way, without leaving the platforms they already trust. It makes cross-border payouts faster, reduces delays, and helps people access their funds quickly in their local currencies. By tapping into Visa Direct’s global network, we take one step closer to mass Web3 adoption.
* **Just one step**
No need to move funds between wallets, exchanges, and banks.
* **Super-fast**
Funds are sent to your Visa card in minutes, not days.
* **More native**
No bank account details required. Just a Visa card number.
* **Secure**
Powered by Mercuryo’s regulated infrastructure and Visa’s global payment network.
Mercuryo is a global fintech infrastructure provider trusted by 250+ companies worldwide. We operate under strong regulatory oversight, with robust security standards and years of experience connecting crypto with traditional finance.
Visa Direct adds speed and reliability on top, enabling real-time payouts to eligible Visa cards, built for everyday money movement. Together, we make cashing out crypto more predictable, safer, and easy.
## How to transfer crypto to your Visa card
* In [Mercuryo widget](https://exchange.mercuryo.io/), choose the crypto you want to cash out * Enter a Visa card details * Receive the funds within minutes
## A bit more about the feature (Q&A)
1. **User choose Visa inside Mercuryo?**
That’s right. When you decide to withdraw crypto from Mercuryo, simply choose Visa option and enter your card number. To do that, you need to be a Mercuryo user. And if you’re not yet, you can easily [become one](https://exchange.mercuryo.io).
2. **I’m not Mercuryo user, can i use Visa Direct?**
You can sign in to Mercuryo and pass KYC. After that, you’ll be able to buy and sell crypto, as well as cash it out to your Visa card.
For even more information, please visit [Mercuryo Help Center](https://help.mercuryo.io/hc/en-gb)

item.title: Mercuryo, Stellar, and LOBSTR Launch 5% USDC Cashback Campaign
item.content:encoded:
# Mercuryo, Stellar, and LOBSTR Launch 5% USDC Cashback Campaign
There’s a difference between holding crypto and using it. Most crypto owners keep their assets as long-term investments or inflation hedges, and very few use them for payments. Mercuryo, Stellar, and LOBSTR are teaming up to make stablecoin use beneficial.
The new campaign offers 5% USDC cashback (up to $50) when users buy USDC via Mercuryo on the Stellar network through LOBSTR Wallet, encouraging everyday transactions.
## Three Platforms, One Goal
Stellar, LOBSTR, and Mercuryo are collaborating to make stablecoin use effortless, combining powerful blockchain infrastructure, a trusted wallet experience, and instant fiat-to-crypto access in one convenient flow.
Stellar provides the foundation: a decentralized, open blockchain network connecting global financial systems. Built for speed, scalability, and accessibility, Stellar enables near-instant settlements with fees that cost just fractions of a cent. Its mission is to make money move like email: fast, affordable, and borderless.
LOBSTR transforms that mission into a user experience accessible to everyone. As a simple and secure wallet, LOBSTR makes it easy to hold, send, and manage digital assets on the Stellar network. From tracking prices to discovering new tokens, LOBSTR serves as the trusted entry point into the Stellar ecosystem.
Mercuryo completes the picture by providing the fiat-to-crypto bridge that brings users onto the network. Through Mercuryo’s on-ramp, anyone can buy USDC directly within LOBSTR, converting local currency into digital assets in just a few taps.
## Understanding the Cashback Campaign
To make stablecoin use more practical, the campaign introduces a cashback model.
Users who buy USDC via Mercuryo on the Stellar network through the LOBSTR Wallet receive 5% cashback on their purchase amount, paid directly in USDC. The total cashback amount is capped at 50 USDC per user for the duration of the campaign.
It’s a straightforward way to encourage genuine on-chain activity, benefitting those who use stablecoins, not just hold them.
## How It Works:
Let’s go through the steps one more time.
1. **Buy USDC via Mercuryo**, choose Stellar as your network. 2. **Use the LOBSTR wallet** to send, hold, or transact with your USDC on Stellar. 3. **Receive 5% cashback in USDC** on your purchase amount, credited directly to your wallet.
*The total cashback amount is capped at 50 USDC per user for the duration of the campaign along with a minimum purchase of 5 USDC.*
*Any not geo listed [here](https://help.mercuryo.io/hc/en-gb/articles/14495532693021-Where-does-Mercuryo-operate) are able to participate. UK is excluded.*
*Cashback will be applied only in one transaction during one hour interval.*
*Cashback payouts will be done every day on business days.*
*Accumulated cashback is available. In case you make 50 USDC on-ramp and one hour after another 50 USDC, you will get 5 USDC cashback.*
For any doubts please contact our Customer Service team [here](https://help.mercuryo.io/hc/en-gb/requests/new).
## Why It Matters
In the United States, cryptocurrency ownership continues to expand, but active use still lags behind. A [recent survey](https://nca.org/2025%20State%20of%20Crypto%20Holders%20Report.pdf) shows that around 21% of U.S. adults now hold crypto, yet only 39% of those holders actually use it to pay for goods and services. That means fewer than 1 in 10 Americans are using digital assets for real transactions.
At the same time, the dominance of USD-pegged stablecoins underscores how central the U.S. dollar has become in digital finance. More [than 90%](https://www.trmlabs.com/reports-and-whitepapers/2025-crypto-adoption-and-stablecoin-usage-report) of all fiat-backed stablecoins are tied to the dollar, according to TRM Labs, with [nearly 99%](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/what-are-stablecoins-and-how-are-they-regulated) of the total stablecoin market cap dollar-denominated.
Given that most on-chain value already moves in dollar terms, networks built for efficient settlement, like Stellar, are positioned to make those transactions faster and more affordable. Stellar processes transfers in seconds with fees measured in fractions of a cent, making it an ideal foundation for stablecoin payments at scale.
## Wrapping Up
Stellar brings the speed and efficiency, LOBSTR delivers a smooth user experience, and Mercuryo makes access effortless. Together, they make using stablecoins straightforward and now, even more worthwhile.
Buy USDC via Mercuryo on the Stellar network through LOBSTR Wallet and receive 5% cashback on your purchase.
Start transacting on Stellar today and see how simple stablecoin payments can be.

item.title: Why 2025 is the Year of RWAs Tokenization
item.content:encoded:
In 2025, Real World Assets (RWAs) have moved from idea to reality. More than $50 billion worth of real estate, debt, equity, and funds is already tokenized. Projects like Franklin Templeton’s on-chain money fund and BlackRock’s digital liquidity fund show how far the market has come.
According to [reports](https://s3.cointelegraph.com/Rwa-Tokenization-Key-Trends-2025-Market-Outlook-Report.pdf), by 2030, tokenized assets could reach $30–50 trillion. The shift isn’t driven by hype but built on stronger technology, clearer regulations, and the momentum of major players leading the way.
RWAs have defined traditional finance for decades, forming the basis for everything from real estate markets to public debt. Tokenization brings a new layer: faster access, broader participation, and the ability to connect ownership with decision-making in ways the old system never allowed.
In this article, we’ll explore how RWA tokenization is opening new possibilities for finance, governance, and broader social change.
## The Current State of RWA Tokenization
By early 2025, tokenizing Real World Assets has moved well beyond experiments. Over $50 billion worth of real estate, commodities, debt, and equity has already been pulled onto blockchains, offering easier access and broader investment options. Real estate was one of the first sectors to move, with platforms like RealT and RedSwan making fractional property ownership possible. Commodities, bonds, and money market funds followed closely.
Challenges remain, especially around regulatory clarity and the speed of adoption among traditional institutions. But momentum is building. Major players like Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, JPMorgan, and Apollo are leading tokenization initiatives, while blockchain platforms such as Stellar, Polygon, and Ethereum provide the infrastructure to scale tokenized assets globally.
## Five Reasons RWAs Are Taking Off in 2025
RWA tokenization is moving faster than ever, and not by accident. Several shifts across technology, regulation, and investment are aligning to bring RWAs into the mainstream.
First, blockchain infrastructure has matured. Platforms like Ethereum, Polygon, and Stellar now offer better scalability, while smart contracts automate complex processes like compliance and profit-sharing with minimal friction.
Second, regulatory clarity is finally arriving. The EU’s MiCA framework and pilot projects from central banks in Europe and Asia have given institutions the green light to move into tokenized markets without second-guessing legal risks.
Third, heavyweight investors are stepping in. BlackRock’s $BUIDL fund, Franklin Templeton’s on-chain initiatives, and JPMorgan’s tokenized credit experiments are no longer pilots—they’re growing fast.
Fourth, blockchain auditability has brought new transparency to traditional asset markets. Real-time proof of reserves, reserve audits, and immutable transaction records strengthen trust without bloating operational costs.
Finally, tokenized RWAs are bridging DeFi and TradFi. Investors now use tokenized bonds, funds, and real estate assets as collateral in DeFi platforms, unlocking new liquidity and yield opportunities that didn’t exist in old financial structures.
## How Tokenization Unlocks Liquidity for Illiquid Assets
Tokenization turns assets once reserved for a few into markets open to many. Through fractional ownership, it becomes possible to trade shares of real estate, private equity, and commodities previously locked behind high entry barriers.
Investors no longer need millions to participate. Owning a share of a property or a fund can start with just a few hundred dollars.
Take real estate. Tokenization has opened the door for fractional ownership of properties, giving smaller investors access to markets once dominated by institutional players. Instead of buying an entire building, investors can now hold a digital share of residential, commercial, or even pre-development projects.
Looking ahead, tokenization could reshape entire industries. Assets like fine art, renewable energy projects, and intellectual property could be divided into tradable pieces. By breaking assets into tradable pieces, tokenization can open global markets where value moves faster and ownership becomes accessible.
## Regulatory Clarity: A Double-Edged Sword
Regulation has long been the missing piece for Real World Asset tokenization. That’s changing fast, but not without new challenges. As lawmakers race to define standards, companies face a maze of requirements that vary by region and asset class. Fragmented rules could slow projects or make cross-border tokenization more complicated than it needs to be.
Still, clearer guidelines offer something the market has been waiting for: confidence. The EU’s MiCA framework is one of the first major examples of structured regulation pushing the market forward. It’s already influencing projects like tokenized money market funds and digital bond issuances across Europe, giving large institutions a clearer path to launch compliant products.
## The Risk of Overregulation
While regulatory clarity is essential, too much control risks freezing the very innovation it aims to support. If tokenized RWAs are boxed into rigid frameworks, smaller players could be locked out, and experimentation could grind to a halt. Instead of entering global markets, tokenization might become just another version of traditional finance.
The DeFi sector offers a warning. Early attempts to regulate decentralized finance often slowed progress by applying old rules to new models, creating confusion without improving security or outcomes. Innovation didn’t stop, but moved to regions with lighter-touch frameworks.
For RWAs, balance is the goal. Regulations should protect investors and ensure market integrity, but they also need to leave enough breathing room for new ideas to grow. The decisions made now could set the tone for a decade of either expansion or stagnation.
## How RWAs Could Reshape Governance and Social Impact
The impact of tokenized RWAs doesn’t have to stop at financial markets. Today, tokenized assets are starting to come with something more than ownership: a real say in decisions.
Imagine a real estate project where token holders vote on community investments, maintenance priorities, or even development strategies. Instead of decisions being made by a few distant stakeholders, entire communities could participate directly through blockchain-based governance tied to real economic assets.
Social projects could move the same way. Tokenizing renewable energy projects, education funds, or healthcare initiatives could give investors both a financial stake and a say in how resources are allocated. Ownership would no longer be passive.
As blockchain infrastructure evolves, RWAs could unlock a new era where asset holders shape not just profits, but policies. Financial participation and civic participation might start to blend in ways traditional systems have never made possible.
## Conclusion
The rise of tokenized Real World Assets is reshaping more than just markets. What began as a push for liquidity and efficiency is creating new ways to share ownership, make decisions, and fund real-world projects. With the right balance of innovation and regulation, RWAs could redefine how communities, investors, and industries organize and grow in the years ahead.
